title: Keep evidence import refusals recoverable and admit exchanges after settled family outcomes
outcome: Stale evidence input cannot strand later repository exchanges, and legacy incoming admission recognizes the shared settled-family contract.
acceptance: A fresh public evidence-apply request with stale selected HEAD refuses without leaving an unrecoverable private recipe that blocks a corrected new exchange; exact retries and uncertainty/custody protections remain intact, including failures after private retention where applicable.

Legacy incoming preparation accepts otherwise valid requests after settled evidence success/refusal and other settled new-family outcomes using the common settlement predicate, while unresolved operations still refuse.
Behavioral regression checks cover public stale-input refusal/recovery and evidence outcome to fresh incoming preparation, with exact owned patch/base/tree and focused results recorded.
